$comment: Things the player can carry. 'at' places an item in the world; 'start' puts it in the pack; 'dark' items cannot be found without a lit lamp in a dark place; 'token' marks one of the masons' carved tokens; 'shown' is the line added to a place's description while the item lies there.

seal.name: the warden's brass seal
seal.shown: On the desk, under a ledger, lies the warden's brass seal.

locket.name: a silver locket
locket.shown: A small silver locket glints in the water.

first token.name: a carved token
first token.shown: A carved token is set into the lichen of the oldest stone.

second token.name: a carved token
second token.shown: A carved token sits on the dry ledge.

third token.name: a carved token
third token.shown: A carved token is wedged in the parapet.

locket.reply: Pell clutches the locket. "Gran's! Thank you. Here, it is all I have."
